notes.title: June update 2.1
notes.content:
Delayed overlay/tile animations
Delays can now be set in the animation settings. This allows very specific button effects as well as more organic layer transitions. 
Also, animation centers have been fixed to really originate with the element's center instead of 0/0.

Pixel exact cursor reacting
Is a new option added to button/tile's layout settings. You can use any cutout images for buttons. 
You can ether hide the background and work with the icon or use theme's mouse hover/press events with different images.

Minor fixes: 
Item owners links checkbox now checked by default in the upload form

notes.title: June 2nd update
notes.content:
Gallery after release updates
The gallery thumbnails have been updated with the authors websites icons. 
You can specify your websites in the new account settings in the settings tab. 

Changes
The volume slider had it's own color settings, which has ne been removed and instead connected to the active theme. You can now select any of the usual themes instead.

Additions
While in edit mode you can now easier transition with the new bring back edit mode, open explorer and open browser icons. 

A tiny core function
..has been implemented: Images of any shape now react pixel exact to cursor hovering. You have to disable the background in the button layout settings for this to activate (+ use a command). 

Other fixes: 
Focused textboxes on widgets don’t steal ctrl+ hotkeys anymore
Texts in the themedesigner have been replaced with icons.
Also there was a bug with downloaded gallery items which has now been fixed. 
+ some copy paste, themedesigner, and small workflow fixes. 

If you had a crash, please don't hesitate and use the also recently implemented report button at the bottom of the overlays overview.

notes.title: June update: Steamworks integration
notes.content:
To be able to enjoy Aurum and get new interfaces straight to your screen, Aurum has been freshly updated with the overlay & theme gallery!
You can now upload, browse and rate others content. 
To enable the new features select beta in Aurum app steam settings. After a week the update will be in non beta. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36151630/227305b9523d5de0806472f80c59e6d0e83bad7a.png

A quick workflow overview
Every uploaded Aurum content can be seen as a pack. A pack can contain a combination of layers and themes.
If you want to publish your content you select public, if you just want to backup, private. 
When you find something you like hit download. The content will be downloaded to your overlays overview and theme pickers. 
You can use the thumbs and heart to rate or favorite others content. 
Soon also added will be: Subscriptions and Links to the owners website. 

Starting today
When you visit the gallery you will note that it's yet pretty "starting up". 
Therefore, this month's task is to find some talented artists to make finding the right command center console you are looking for easy. 
As the exchange, links to the artists websites can be visibly placed in each preview. 


Another small upgrade.. 
To celebrate the upcoming summer an experimental feature has been added: Shadows. Next to the border and background settings you will now also find the shadow options. 
As shadows usually tend to be an esthetic factor see for yourself what they can do. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36151630/1f96ed10188633c7dedfdd5f82feb86b621d76b8.png

Thanks!
Also big and first thanks to everyone who bought Aurum, it is an appreciated support. I work on updates almost every day, and things will keep being upgraded.


If you want to get involved or drop any thought contact me or visit the forums!

notes.title: May update bringing hotcorners available in beta now
notes.content:
One of Aurums main goals is to bring functions fast, 
So far this was handled by hotkeys only (connected to dpi button on mouse for extra speed).
To make aurum more versatile, hotcorners have been added to the overlay trigger options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36151630/b4946c06d1bd68ca463f07dbea36d2baea7ef71a.png

They come with adjustable lengths and delays.

Also above two new useful functions:
The green smart activate/deactivate whole overlay button as well as the load overlay on start option.



Additionally the following have been fixed or updated: 
Fixed crashing with empty layer animations
More intuitive layer settings
Fixed several multiscreen features
Fixed some edit mode details
Fixed jump to mouse layers, fixed for multiscreen
Fixed selected layer when entering edit mode
Quality now to decreasing with zoom animations



Any input appreciated! If you can spare some time visit the forums and drop your two cents. 
Next update is probably going to be the steam gallery connected module or performance counters. 
Tune in!

notes.title: Late February Update
notes.content:
NEW FEATURES / IMPROVEMENTS

 To have access to the any drive folder, Aurum now added a right click directory menu to every folder item. (Files will open their parent folder) 
 There is a new crashcourse accessible by pressing F1. You can parkour through all of Aurums possibilities. Changes and additions to the parkour will be mentioned in changelogs. 
 For the F buttons, F3 is now accessible anytime to open the settings window. 
 While editing, you now have a taskbar icon to switch to aurum (or drag an item there to show aurum). 
 You can now drag any of an element's edges to resize. 
 As Aurum adapts it's settings windows got it's own style. 
 Every window can now be closed with the escape key. You can also use it to hide Aurum.
 A corresponding context settings menu will now open whenever a new item is created. It will stay on position when switching between the elements. 
 To ensure consistance and struggle free workflow Aurum will now kill any other instance when started. 
 Next to dropping, Aurum now implements dialogs for picking files. They be found on brush pickers, in the run command settings context menu, As well as when right clicking the background you can add  an transparent backgorund (cutout png) image right away. 


FIXES

 There might have been slow starts which now have been fixed. 
 As there is a windows window menu accessible by pressing alt (followed by space), that has been disabled for aurum to make the alt key fully functional.

notes.title: Febrauary Update - spotlight: F2 edit mode
notes.content:
Aurum just got a cleaner workflow and interface. 
To access the Edit mode you simply have to press F2. 
You can drop in files, folders and urls anywhere on the background surface or rightclick to select what to create from scratch. 

In Edit mode the animations are disabled so you can switch faster between your system and browser. 

System Tray Icon
Aurum is now represented in the systray. You can double click it to open Aurum, as well as right click it to open other Aurum options like settings. 

Start with windows
.. checkbox has been added to the general settings. 

Additional hotkeys
F1 has been added to open the community hub guides section. 
F3 now opens the settings window. 

Upcoming features
This months' next update will at least include sound effects for startup, closing and clicking and hovering icons.
Improvements to the search, task and audio controls and probably a new addon widget to control music. 


Feedback appreciated! 
Have a nice february

notes.title: Early 2020 New features update
notes.content:
So far Aurum has already been comfortably functional. 
The new update brings a lot of functions that were necessary to round the experience. 
Read below for the full list of completing features and where they will go in future. 

Theme editor
You can now find it in the Aurum settings. It comes with a couple of predefined themes. 
You can take any, duplicate it and create the type of style you would your overlay want to be.
Especially interesting is to use images instead of colors. Just drag and drop an image to the field and change the tilemode to Tile or FlipXY. 
If you need more skinability, there will be additional possibilities and a more sophisticated theme editor layout within the next months. 

Hide and show animations
You can now change the way the overlay appears and disappears in the general settings. So far your can adjust the opacity, and sliding values, we will be adding additional possibilities in the future updates. That would include bounce effects, zoom, etc. 

Fullscreen background color
Can be found in the general settings. Makes it feel more like you can forget the whole other system when opening Aurum. 

Gridsize
For smooth editing there will be more features in the next months, so far the grid is helping to reposition Aurum's elements. 

Button background picture zoom & pan
You can now just drop a picture from your files or the browser on any icon. To adjust it you can then use the mouse wheel to zoom and drag to change the offset. 

Tiles with regular mouse arrow
You can create background squares with background pictures, with an empty command field they will have the regular mouse arrow, looking not clickable. 

Updates to the time addon
With the new time addon you can add multiple elements with a different time format. 
Independently you can add time, date, hours or minutes only etc. and change the font and color for each. Right click on the existing one opens the new context menu. 

[strike]The F1 window
Press F1 to open a window containing new features upon an update and the complete user guide. 
[/strike]

Aurum commands
So far did handle all the external windows commands, now it comes with internal commands as well. You can find them if you click "browse presets" in a command tile's menu. 
The commands are: aurum settings general, aurum settings hotkeys, aurum settings addons, aurum help, aurum close.



Next features coming at some point in february!
